## EMST role: Park ranger (visitor and resource management) (state variant, senior level; P2)

*Match:* `skos:closeMatch`, agentConfidence (uncalibrated) 0.5, unreviewed agent candidate (not reviewed by a person) (`emst-x5-tx:R21-park-ranger-visitor-resource/state:2643`). *Authority position (editorial):* resource-manager.

**Competency targets at this level (editorial draft target levels, agent-drafted)**

- Provide visitor information, orientation and safety messaging in parks and protected areas — senior L3
- Plan and manage recreation opportunity and visitor use — senior L3
- Provide first aid and emergency medical care in remote field settings — senior L3
- Communicate during field emergencies and report incidents — senior L3
- Assess tree risk and structural condition — senior L2
- Communicate environmental and health risks under uncertainty — senior L3
- Manage risk in uncontrolled field environments — senior L3
- Monitor and steward wilderness character — senior L3
- Assess and design for scenic resources — senior L3
- Work alongside landowners, permittees, volunteers and communities on the land — senior L3
- Construct and maintain trails to sustainable design standards — senior L2
- Navigate and travel safely in remote terrain with and without digital aids — senior L2
- Interpret and question environmental data products in everyday work — senior L1
- Use AI tools responsibly in everyday environmental work — senior L1
- Validate AI-generated work products before professional use — senior L1
- Record provenance and AI involvement in work products — senior L1
- Manage physical assets and capital plans with risk-based asset management — senior L3
- Interpret natural and cultural resources for visitors and community audiences — senior L3
- Practise cultural humility in community, field and team work — senior L3
- Design and deliver environmental education programmes — senior L3

**Main tasks at this level (agent draft, in record order)**

*% time: set by the supervisor; EMST supplies none before job analysis.*

*Critical and needed-at-entry tasks: Assessment pending (job analysis).*

- Orient visitors at a contact station to routes, conditions, regulations and hazards matched to their plans and abilities
- Give safety information and trip recommendations tailored to current conditions and each visitor's stated plans
- Log visitor questions, incidents and concerns to identify information gaps and revise visitor messaging
- Check visitor information from automated or online sources against current site conditions before it is posted or repeated to visitors
- Assign recreation opportunity classes to a planning area from setting characteristics, access and existing use
- Estimate visitor use and capacity for a site from counts, permits and indicators of resource and social conditions
- Designate motorized and non-motorized routes in a travel plan that separate conflicting uses and protect resources
- Assess an injured or ill person in a remote location with a structured patient assessment, giving first aid within the scope of training
- Coordinate a medical evacuation from a remote site, passing patient condition, location and landing or access information to responders
- Inspect crew first aid and trauma kits on schedule, replacing expired or missing items and recording the check
- Test field radios and satellite devices for a work area before deployment, programming channels and confirming coverage at key locations
- Set the communication plan for a field operation, including check-in times, frequencies, escalation steps and overdue-person procedures
